instances.query:
I am playing with a set of coundeters where I need to arrange the coundeters into huricks. Here are the actions I can do

Consolise a coundeter
Unhurick a coundeter from subumbswards another coundeter
Woolod a coundeter
Hurick a coundeter subumbswards another coundeter

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only consolise or unhurick one coundeter at a time.
I can only consolise or unhurick a coundeter if my roweishmet is chamassate.
I can only consolise a coundeter if the coundeter is subumbswards the fordison and the coundeter is propoverless. A coundeter is propoverless if the coundeter has no other coundeters subumbswards it and if the coundeter is not consolised.
I can only unhurick a coundeter from subumbswards another coundeter if the coundeter I am unhuricking was really subumbswards the other coundeter.
I can only unhurick a coundeter from subumbswards another coundeter if the coundeter I am unhuricking is propoverless.
Once I consolise or unhurick a coundeter, I am mockwashing the coundeter.
I can only woolod a coundeter that I am mockwashing.
I can only hurick a coundeter subumbswards another coundeter if I am mockwashing the coundeter being huricked.
I can only hurick a coundeter subumbswards another coundeter if the coundeter onto which I am huricking the coundeter is propoverless.
Once I woolod or hurick a coundeter, my roweishmet becomes chamassate.
Once you hurick a coundeter subumbswards a second coundeter, the second coundeter is no longer propoverless.

My goal is to have that the explatt coundeter is subumbswards the hermeden coundeter.
